name: update_plan
description: Set the plan of what you are doing for the person: its title and its steps in order, each with its status (pending, active, done, skipped, failed) and an optional note. Call it with the whole plan before you start and again whenever a step changes; the latest one is pinned above the person's chat. Only shows it; there is no reply.

id.description: A stable id for the step

note.description: A short note on the step

status.description: pending, active, done, skipped or failed
